description: Trigger precision eval: verify ue-cpp-refactor activates on refactoring/rename/extract queries and NOT on scaffold/create/build queries

cases.reason: Korean '리팩터링' — core trigger
Korean '리네임' — rename trigger with specific classes
English 'rename class' — direct trigger
Korean '함수 추출' — exact trigger pattern from routing.json (not '메서드 추출')
English 'extract method' — direct trigger
Korean '클래스 이름 변경' — class rename trigger
English 'rename function' — function rename trigger
English 'change signature' — direct trigger
Korean '함수 추출' — function extraction trigger
English 'safe delete' — safe deletion trigger
TN: '만들어줘' is ue-scaffold trigger. Creating new features, not refactoring existing code.
TN: 'Create' is ue-scaffold trigger. New class creation, not refactoring.
TN: 'Build' is ue-scaffold trigger. New feature construction, not refactoring.
TN: '에러 해결' is ue-debug trigger. Error fixing, not refactoring.
TN: '어떻게 동작' is ue-explain trigger. Explanation, not refactoring.
TN: 'Scaffold' is ue-scaffold trigger. Generating new UI, not refactoring.
TN: '변경하면 깨져' is ue-impact trigger. Impact analysis, not refactoring.
TN: '테스트 생성' is ue-test-gen trigger. Test creation, not refactoring.
TN: '진단' is ue-audit trigger. Project health, not refactoring.
TN: 'Set up' is ue-scaffold trigger. Feature scaffolding, not code refactoring.
